entry.title: House prices up by 4.0% in the euro area
entry.summary: In the second quarter of 2026, house prices, as measured by the House Price Index, increased by 4.0% in the euro area and by 4.7% in the EU compared with the same quarter of the previous year. entry.title: Euro area annual inflation up to 3.3%
entry.summary: Euro area annual inflation is expected to be 3.3% in August 2026, up from 2.9% in July according to a flash estimate from Eurostat, the statistical office of the European Union.

entry.title: Household real income per capita stays stable in the euro area and increases in the EU
entry.summary: In the first quarter of 2026, household real income per capita stayed stable in the euro area, after an increase of 0.2% in the fourth quarter of 2025. In the same period, household real consumption per capita also stayed stable, after an increase of 0.5% in the previous quarter.

entry.title: Government debt at 88.9% of GDP in euro area
entry.summary: At the end of the first quarter of 2026, the general government gross debt to GDP ratio in the euro area (EA21) stood at 88.9%, an increase compared with 87.7% at the end of the fourth quarter of 2025. In the EU, the ratio also increased from 81.8% to 82.9%.
